name: Pickle
long_description: Pickle is the personal AI agent network for Asia. Instead of building another chatbot or an overcrowded super-app, Pickle replaces daily life administration with an "invisible super-app" powered by autonomous background tool execution—handling restaurant bookings, store phone calls, delivery tracking, administrative paperwork, and local payments without user micromanagement. Because every user gets a dedicated agent with persistent memory and local context, Pickles naturally connect with one another: coordinating schedules between friends, exchanging local recommendations, and delegating shared errands. Driven by 70%+ D1 retention and strong organic viral loops (K-factor > 1.2), this creates an unprecedented Agent-to-Agent (A2A) network effect. Starting with Korea and Japan, Pickle integrates deeply with local messaging (Kakao, LINE), local identity, and payment rails to become the default consumer execution layer across 670M people in Asia.
one_liner: The personal AI agent network for Asia
